textos.As opiniões divergem sobre a eficácia do: Opinions diverge on the effectiveness of the work's script and structure. While most of those who recommend it praise the writing for its intelligence and originality, nearly all of those who do not recommend it point out that the figures on screen are poorly built and do not prompt identification.
textos.Várias reviews descrevem o filme como ex: Several reviews describe the film as excessively slow, with long periods in which nothing seems to happen, making the experience drawn-out and hard to follow.
textos.Personagens pouco desenvolvidos e difíce: Underdeveloped characters that are hard to connect with
textos.Alguns espectadores afirmam que não cons: Some viewers say they could not care about the characters, considering them shallow and without emotional depth, which hurt their involvement with the story.
textos.O roteiro é criticado por deixar pontas: The script is criticized for leaving loose ends, offering insufficient explanations and rushed development, with events that arise without adequate preparation.
textos.A reviravolta do final é apontada como ó: The twist at the end is pointed out as obvious, poorly built or unsatisfying, sounding like an easy solution rather than a deserved conclusion.
textos.O filme é visto como pretensioso e artif: The film is seen as pretentious and artificially emotional, with a style that takes itself too seriously and dialogue that sounds fake or cheesy.
textos.Cinematografia e efeitos visuais elogiad: Praised cinematography and visual effects, but not enough
textos.Apesar de reconhecerem a qualidade estét: Although they acknowledge the aesthetic quality and the effects, many consider that the beautiful visuals do not make up for the flaws in story and pacing.
textos.Várias reviews medianas reclamam que o f: Several middling reviews complain that the film is slow to get going and that the first half is boring, with some saying they almost gave up before getting involved.
textos.Este grupo aponta que a premissa é inter: This group points out that the premise is interesting, but the execution and the development of the story sound confusing, with poorly used ideas and an unsatisfying ending.
textos.As reviews medianas costumam elogiar a b: Middling reviews tend to praise the visual beauty, the design of the aliens and the atmospheric sound, considering these the best aspects of the film.
textos.Crítica à propaganda estadunidense e à g: Criticism of American propaganda and geopolitics
textos.Algumas reviews medianas criticam o retr: Some middling reviews criticize the stereotyped portrayal of other nations and the view that the United States would be the only rational and peaceful one, which is bothersome during the screening.
textos.Há quem diga que o filme recorre a clich: Some say the film resorts to genre clichés, such as family trauma and generic characters, which makes the work seem derived from other science fiction.
textos.Parte deste grupo considera as atuações: A portion of this group considers the performances good, but finds the protagonist lacking personality or the characters unengaging.
textos.Várias reviews positivas elogiam a atuaç: Several positive reviews praise Amy Adams's performance as restrained and full of nuance, able to convey deep emotions with subtlety.
textos.A trilha sonora, incluindo composições d: The score, including compositions by Max Richter and Jóhann Jóhannsson, is highlighted for creating an emotional, immersive atmosphere.
textos.A fotografia e os visuais são elogiados: The cinematography and visuals are praised for their beauty and their ability to create a contemplative, melancholic atmosphere.
textos.O roteiro é descrito como inteligente, o: The script is described as smart, original and well structured, tackling complex concepts in an engaging way.
textos.Temas de tempo, amor e escolha: Themes of time, love and choice
textos.As reviews destacam a reflexão sobre tem: Reviews highlight the reflection on non-linear time, the acceptance of suffering and the decision to live fully even while knowing the pains to come.
textos.A direção de Denis Villeneuve é elogiada: Denis Villeneuve's direction is praised for its elegance, control of pace and skill in balancing science fiction and human emotion.

textos.Dirigido por Denis Villeneuve e lançado: Directed by Denis Villeneuve and released in 2016, Arrival is a 116-minute science fiction and mystery drama. In the story, when interplanetary ships leave marks on Earth, a linguist is recruited by the military to translate the alien messages and find out whether these beings pose a threat to humanity.
textos.O filme se desenvolve por meio de um rit: The film develops at a slowed, steady pace, sustained by a contemplative atmosphere and a composition focused on sound design and visual aspects.
textos.Em termos de recepção, os grupos avaliam: In terms of reception, the groups assess the same elements of the work and agree on its structure, diverging in the verdict on how it functions. Among the vast majority of ratings (~85%), a significant share praises Amy Adams's performance, a good portion values the score and sound, and a considerable number highlight the quality of the cinematography and visuals.
textos.Numa fração mínima das notas (~12%), a l: In a minimal fraction of ratings (~12%), the reading of the production becomes mixed: several point to the slow, drawn-out pace, many complain of a confusing script and frustrating execution, while a portion keep their praise for the cinematography and score. Finally, from the perspective of those who make up an even smaller fraction of ratings (~3%), the criticisms are dominant: about half reject the slow, boring pace, a significant share points to underdeveloped characters that are hard to connect with, and many indicate a confusing script with holes.
